svg.aria-label: Figure 1.4: Architectural 3/4 Cutaway of the Ziggurat of Ur showing kiln-baked brick armor, bitumen mortar, sun-dried mudbrick core, woven reed mats, braided cables, triple staircase, and rainwater weep-holes
svg.text: Figure 1.4: Ziggurat of Ur — Layered Mudbrick Cutaway (c. 2100 BCE)
Built under King Ur-Nammu with zero local stone: reed mats stop sliding, kiln-baked bricks and bitumen block rain
